title: I2S: microphones, DACs, and digital audio

questions.prompt: Which option states the main idea of “I2S: microphones, DACs, and digital audio” correctly?
options: CAN is a noise-tolerant differential, message-based bus used in vehicle ECUs, industrial control, and robotics.
I2S carries digital audio using bit clock (BCLK), word select (WS/LRCLK), and data lines.

questions.explanation: I2S carries digital audio using bit clock (BCLK), word select (WS/LRCLK), and data lines.
